title: Code of Civil Procedure Amendment Act 1992

sections.shortTitle: Code of Civil Procedure Amendment Act 1992
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT VI OF 1992
ACT VI OF 1992
CODE OF CIVIL
PROCEDURE (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1992
An Act further to
amend the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 30th May, 1992]
The following Act of
Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of the President on the 24th
May, 1992, and is hereby published for general information:--
1. Short title and
commencement.---(1) This Act may be called the Code of Civil Procedure
(Amendment) Act, 1992.
(2) 1t shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Code of Civil Procedure Amendment Act 1992
sections.description:
Amendment of section 102, Act V of 1908

ACT VI OF 1992
ACT VI OF 1992
CODE OF CIVIL
PROCEDURE (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1992
An Act further to
amend the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 30th May, 1992]
The following Act of
Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of the President on the 24th
May, 1992, and is hereby published for general information:--
2. Amendment of section 102,
Act V of 1908.----In the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 (Act V of 1908),
hereinafter referred to as the said Code, in section 102, in clause (b), for
the words "fifty thousand rupees" the words "one hundred
thousand rupees" shall be substituted.

Amendment of section 115, Act V of 1908

ACT VI OF 1992
ACT VI OF 1992
CODE OF CIVIL
PROCEDURE (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1992
An Act further to
amend the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 30th May, 1992]
The following Act of
Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of the President on the 24th
May, 1992, and is hereby published for general information:--
3. Amendment of section 115,
Act V of 1908.--In the said Code, in section 115, in subsection (1), in the
proviso, for the full-stop at the end, a colon shall be substituted and
thereafter the following further proviso shall be added, namely:--
"Provided further that such
application shall be made within ninety days of the decision of the subordinate
Court."
